description_en: Deletes video recording files stored in the cloud
description_zh: 删除云端存储的录像文件
name: DeleteRecord

parameters.help_en:
The list of recording file names to delete. You can obtain recording file names by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107922.html.

A maximum of 50 recording files can be deleted at a time
parameters.help_zh:
待删除的录像文件名列表。录像文件名可使用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/107922.html获取。

单次最多支持删除50个的录像文件
parameters.name: file_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html to query information about all products under the current account.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName。
</notice>
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name of the IPC device.
You can view the DeviceName on the Devices page in the IoT Platform console.
<notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的设备页查看DeviceName。
<notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey。
</notice>
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html of IoT Platform to query the device ID.

<notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds one-to-one with the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify IotId together with ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69594.html查询。

<notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName的组合，则以IotId为准。
</notice>
parameters.name: iot_id

DeletedCount.description_zh: 成功删除的录像文件数量

ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
